name: Exp_XDerivative
summary: This EA trades based on the XDerivative custom indicator, which calculates a smoothed derivative of price. It opens buy positions when the derivative turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable money management and separate buy/sell open/close controls.
summary_zh: 该EA基于XDerivative自定义指标进行交易，该指标计算价格的平滑导数。当导数向上转折时开多仓，向下转折时开空仓，支持可配置的资金管理和独立的买卖开平仓控制。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于XDerivative指标的导数变化来判断价格动量的转折。入场条件：当Value[1]<Value[2]（指标下降趋势中）且Value[0]>Value[1]（当前值回升）时，产生买入信号；当Value[1]>Value[2]（指标上升趋势中）且Value[0]<Value[1]（当前值回落）时，产生卖出信号。这本质上是捕捉动量的拐点，属于动量反转交易策略。出场条件通过反向信号触发平仓，同时设置了固定的StopLoss和TakeProfit进行风险控制。仓位管理支持五种模式：按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按扣除亏损后的可用保证金比例、按扣除亏损后的余额比例、以及固定手数。指标使用JJMA等高级平滑算法对价格导数进行平滑处理，减少了噪声干扰但可能引入滞后。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the derivative changes of the XDerivative indicator to identify price momentum turning points. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when Value[1]<Value[2] (indicator in downtrend) and Value[0]>Value[1] (current value rising), meaning the derivative is turning up from a decline; a sell signal is generated when Value[1]>Value[2] (indicator in uptrend) and Value[0]<Value[1] (current value falling), meaning the derivative is turning down from a rise. This is essentially capturing momentum inflection points, classifying it as a momentum reversal trading strategy. Exit conditions are triggered by opposing signals, with fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit providing risk control. Position sizing supports five modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin after losses, percentage of balance after losses, and fixed lot size. The indicator uses advanced smoothing algorithms like JJMA to smooth the price derivative, reducing noise but potentially introducing lag.

parameters.description_en: Money management ratio controlling risk per trade

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（可用保证金/余额/扣除亏损后等）
parameters.description_en: Lot sizing mode: free margin/balance/net free margin/net balance/fixed lots

parameters.description_en: Allow opening long position on bullish signal

parameters.name: SellPosOpen
parameters.description_en: Allow opening short position on bearish signal

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing long position on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing short position on reverse signal

pros: 使用高级平滑算法（JJMA等）处理价格导数，有效降低市场噪声
买卖开平仓独立控制，策略灵活性高，可只做单边或只平仓不开仓
支持五种仓位管理模式，资金管理方案完善
使用IsNewBar机制避免同一根K线内重复交易
有固定的止损止盈设置，风险可控
pros_en: Uses advanced smoothing algorithms (JJMA etc.) to process price derivatives, effectively reducing market noise
Independent buy/sell open/close controls provide high strategy flexibility, allowing one-direction-only or close-only modes
Supports five position sizing modes with comprehensive money management options
Uses IsNewBar mechanism to prevent repeated trades within the same bar
Has fixed stop loss and take profit settings for controllable risk
cons: 依赖自定义指标XDerivative，指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值偏大，可能在低波动市场中造成过大亏损
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能频繁被止损
信号基于导数拐点，在震荡市中可能产生大量虚假信号
缺乏对已有持仓的检查，可能重复开仓
代码中注释为乱码（编码问题），可读性差
cons_en: Depends on custom XDerivative indicator; EA cannot run if the indicator file is missing
Default SL of 1000 and TP of 2000 points are large, potentially causing oversized losses in low-volatility markets
No spread filter, may frequently hit stop loss in high-spread environments
Signals based on derivative inflection points may generate numerous false signals in ranging markets
Lacks check for existing positions, potentially opening duplicate trades
Code comments are garbled (encoding issue), severely hurting readability
improvements: 增加点差过滤和波动率过滤，避免在不利条件下开仓
增加持仓检查逻辑，防止同方向重复开仓
增加追踪止损功能，在盈利时保护利润
将止损止盈改为ATR动态计算，适应不同市场波动率
improvements_en: Add spread filter and volatility filter to avoid opening positions under unfavorable conditions
Add position check logic to prevent duplicate trades in the same direction
Add trailing stop functionality to protect profits when in gain
Change SL/TP to ATR-based dynamic calculation to adapt to different market volatilities

risk_points: 缺乏持仓检查，可能同方向重复开仓导致仓位过重
固定止损止盈不适应市场波动率变化，极端行情下可能不足
依赖外部自定义指标，指标加载失败时EA直接初始化失败
没有点差过滤，高点差环境下交易成本可能吞噬利润
risk_points_en: Lacks position check, potentially opening duplicate same-direction trades leading to overexposure
Fixed SL/TP does not adapt to market volatility changes, may be insufficient during extreme moves
Depends on external custom indicator; indicator load failure causes EA initialization failure
No spread filter; high spread environments may erode profits with trading costs
